packageRules.description: Supply-chain hardening (Art. X): wait 7 days before proposing newly published versions
Group non-major devDependency bumps into one PR
Keep the pinned pnpm packageManager field current

description: minimatch is in ignoreDeps because patches/minimatch@3.1.5.patch applies to that exact version and Renovate does not read pnpm patchedDependencies. pnpm-workspace.yaml pins it too; the pin, the patch and this entry move together, by hand, or not at all.
